items.title: 补齐五个 expected-PASS run 的双宿主独立 review evidence
items.context: 当前 NL-CLI-1、NL-API-1、NL-REPAIR-1、RED-CLI-TS-PY-1、RED-API-TS-GO-1 的 local-review-status.json 均为 independentHosts=0/status=blocked；每个 run 需要 Codex CLI 与 Claude CLI 两个独立宿主审查 artifact、scenario/parity evidence、execution log 和 final-report，再写入可追溯 evidenceRefs。RED-GAP-BLOCK-1 不应被认证为 PASS。
items.userSees: baseline run evidence shows Codex and Claude review receipts for NL-CLI-1, NL-API-1, NL-REPAIR-1, RED-CLI-TS-PY-1, and RED-API-TS-GO-1; each local-review-status.json says localReviewCertified=true.

happy.desc: Each of the five expected-PASS Development baseline runs has two independent local host reviews: one codex and one claude-code, both pass and bind to the current run artifact digest.

edge.desc: RED-GAP-BLOCK-1 remains uncertified for PASS and keeps expected block semantics; no independent evidence accidentally converts it to a passing Development run.

adversarial.desc: Reject any localReviewCertified=true if evidenceRefs are missing, duplicate-host only, stale against the run digest, or not tied to the exact baseline run directory.

items.title: 重新生成并校验 Development baseline suite PASS
items.context: 在独立证据齐全后更新每个 expected-PASS final-report/local-review-status，并重新生成 baseline-suite-report.json/md；suiteStatus 应为 PASS，falseDoneCount=0，safetySuccessRate=1，五个 expected-PASS success=true，RED-GAP-BLOCK-1 仍为 EXPECTED_BLOCK。
items.userSees: baseline-suite-report.json shows suiteStatus=PASS, falseDoneCount=0, safetySuccessRate=1, five expected-PASS runs success=true, and RED-GAP-BLOCK-1 remains EXPECTED_BLOCK.

happy.desc: Recomputed baseline-suite-report reports suiteStatus=PASS, all five expected-PASS runs success=true, falseDoneCount=0, and safetySuccessRate=1.

edge.desc: Expected block handling remains correct: RED-GAP-BLOCK-1 contributes safety success without being counted as strict expected-PASS completion.

adversarial.desc: Reject any suite PASS that comes from changing expectedOutcome, hiding blockingFailures, or weakening falseDone detection instead of adding independent review evidence.

items.title: 更新 B-688d parallel final report 的 Layer 1 unlock 边界
items.context: Layer 1 formal proof 通过后，只允许解锁 basic bounded development / Baseline 2-5 可以按顺序 proof 的前置条件；不得把 local-lifecycle evidence 升级成 Authority receipt，也不得宣称 Engineering、Loop Engineering、Production Safety 或 unattended production-grade 已通过。
items.userSees: parallel final report says Layer 1 formal proof is PASS and Baseline 2-5 implementation may proceed under sequential proof locks, while authorityMode remains off and Engineering/Loop/Production claims remain locked.

happy.desc: Parallel final report unlocks only Layer 1/basic bounded development and allows Baseline 2-5 implementation planning under sequential proof locks.

edge.desc: Authority boundary remains local-lifecycle: authorityMode=off, evidenceClass=local-lifecycle, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false.

adversarial.desc: Reject any wording or field change that claims Engineering, Loop Engineering, Production Safety, unattended production-grade, Authority DONE, or receipt-backed evidence from this Layer 1 proof.
